name: smart-travel-planner
description: A research-first travel decision workflow with evidence-gated autonomous replanning, constraint-aware routes, budgets, and a Word handbook.

interface.shortDescription: Research-first travel planning with evidence and a Word handbook

defaultPrompt: Build a realistic trip budget and itinerary.
